On Sep 30, 2028, at 9:12 AM, Tanya Roy <tanya@orchardai.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick turnaround on onboarding. Attached are the company bank letter and our W‑9. ...

A few quick items from our side so we can schedule the first pay run: 
1) Yes, we typically do a single micro‑deposit to confirm ACH routing (we can skip if you prefer a wire validation). If you want the micro‑deposit, we’ll post it within 48 hours and send the test amount for confirmation.
2) We need the remittance to include a dedicated PO field of exactly 10 characters (we prefer the format RWPO-XXXXX). Can you map your system to emit that as a discrete CSV column? The sample you attached is helpful.
3) Please confirm the EIN shown on the W‑9 matches the remit and bank letter — the finance team will cross‑check during the first payment.

Marissa — can you please confirm the PO field name we should ask Orchard to emit back (invoice_remit_po or po_reference)? David, flag any risks on the ACH routing.

Tanya — once Marissa confirms the PO field name, I’ll kick off the micro‑deposit (if requested) and queue Orchard for a first pay run on Oct 9.

Best,
Sean
Director, PayOps

Hello Tanya — good to meet you via email.

On Sep 30, 2028, at 10:05 AM, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> A few quick items from our side so we can schedule the first pay run: ...

To keep downstream reconciliation simple please map the PO into a top‑level CSV column named "remit_po". Example expected output (CSV columns): invoice_date, invoice_number, remit_po, remit_amount, remit_currency, remit_note. If your billing platform cannot rename the column, you can also include a second column named "po_reference" but the authoritative value must be in remit_po.

Additional requirements: 
- Invoice attachments should include the Redwood PO number prominently on the first page.
- For ACH net‑30 we require invoices to be labeled with the invoice type code "INV‑RDW" in the remit_note column.
- If you prefer wires for the first payment, tell us and we’ll allow a one‑time wire with beneficiary name matching the bank letter.

We will proceed with a micro‑deposit to the ACH account you provided unless you request a wire test. Micro‑deposit will be under $1 and will show as "RW TEST" on the transaction memo. Please confirm the account holder name exactly as it appears on Orchard AI bank records (case sensitive).

Thanks — will follow up with the micro‑deposit transaction details once Sean initiates.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Vendor Onboarding 
Redwood Inference
